name: VSTECS Berhad
overview: VSTECS 今年完成出售其在 ISATEC Sdn Bhd 的 40% 股权，ISATEC 自 2026 年 10 月 28 日起不再为联营公司。公司同时进行红股发行，并宣派股息。最新一季（2026-06-30）营收同比增长 31.7%，净利润同比增长 50.3%。
overview_en: VSTECS completed the disposal of its 40% equity interest in ISATEC Sdn Bhd this year, with ISATEC ceasing to be an associate company from 28 October 2026. The company also undertook a bonus issue and declared dividends. In the latest quarter (30 June 2026), revenue rose 31.7% year-on-year and net profit rose 50.3% year-on-year.

actions.text_en: Proposed disposal of 233,334 ISATEC shares (40% equity interest) to Skyform Pte Ltd for a cash consideration of RM48,751,685.97.
